author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Lord Juss sat in the high seat midmost of the dais, with Goldry on his right in the seat of black opal, and on his left Spitfire, throned on the alexandrite. On the dais sat likewise those other lords of Demonland, and the guests of lower degree thronged the benches and the polished tables as the wide doors opened on their silver hinges, and the Ambassador with pomp and ceremony paced up the shining floor of marble and green tourmaline.

text: 朱斯勳爵坐喺台上中間嘅高位，右邊係高德里，坐喺黑色蛋白石座位，左邊係噴火機，坐喺亞歷山大石上面。 喺台上，同樣坐咗嗰啲魔地嘅其他領主，而低級嘅客人就擠滿咗長凳同拋光嘅枱，因為闊門喺佢哋嘅銀色鍊條上面打開，而大使喺大理石同綠色電鍍石嘅閃閃發光嘅地板上行緊。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Can I have a ticket?" "Yes, you can. In fact I'd recommend this one." "But I mean: can I buy a ticket?" "I'm surprised you're asking me that question. How do I know if you can buy a ticket? It depends on what's in your wallet." "Come on, you know – I'd like to buy a ticket." "And I can sell a ticket." "What a stroke of luck! So give me a ticket, please!" "There you go." "Finally!"

text: 「我可唔可以有張飛？」「係呀，你可以。其實我會推薦呢個。」「但我嘅意思係：我可唔可以買飛？」 「我好驚訝你問我呢個問題。我點知你買唔買到飛？睇你銀包入面有啲咩。」「嚟啦，你知啦 —— 我想買張飛。」「我可以賣飛。」 「好彩呀！噉畀張飛我啦，唔該！」「你去啦。」「最終！」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the 25th of April of 2025. In the still sunny early evening, around 18:00, I found myself again in Tim Hortons café, this time to enjoy an Earl Grey tea with oat milk, a Crispy Chicken Craveable sandwich, and a Lemon Poppyseed Muffin. There was a corpulent man who was partly Amerindian. Salish, I presume. There were some Bharati scattered about in the hall. Homebound, I noticed that the blue mountains in the horizon are still topped with snow.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 4 jyut6 25 hou6。hai2 jing4 jin4 cing4 long5 ge3 pong4 maan5，daai6 joek3 18 dim2，ngo5 jau6 faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 hai2 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 gun2，gam1 ci3 hai6 hoeng2 jung6 jat1 bui1 baak3 zoek3 caa4 pui3 maai4 jin3 mak6 naai5，jat1 go3 ceoi3 gai1 ho2 soeng2 sik6 ge3 saam1 man4 zi6，tung4 maai4 jat1 go3 ning4 mung1 aang1 suk1 zi2 sung1 beng2。jau5 go3 fei4 bun6 ge3 naam4 jan2，keoi5 jau5 bou6 fan6 hai6 mei5 zau1 jan3 dai6 on1 jan4。ngo5 teoi1 caak1，saat3 lei6 sap6。hai2 go3 daai6 tong4 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 baa1 laai1 tai4 jan4 saan3 lok6 lai4。faan1 uk1 kei2，ngo5 lau4 ji3 dou3 dei6 ping4 sin3 soeng6 ge3 laam4 sik1 saan1 mak6 zung6 hai6 syut3 ding2。
text: 今日係2025年4月25號。喺仍然晴朗嘅傍晚，大約18點，我又發現自己喺 Tim Hortons 咖啡館，今次係享用一杯伯爵茶配埋燕麥奶，一個脆雞可想食嘅三文治，同埋一個檸檬罌粟籽鬆餅。有個肥胖嘅男人，佢有部分係美洲印第安人。我推測，薩利什。喺個大堂入面有啲巴拉提人散落嚟。返屋企，我留意到地平線上嘅藍色山脈仲係雪頂。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Most of the players are rushing to enjoy endgame content, while I'm sitting here at the auction house enjoying the game of arbitrage: buying items cheaply when I notice them, then reselling them to other players at slightly under the normal price, and enjoying the profit. Is this really gaming? Hey, I'm having fun with it, so why not?

jyutping: daai6 bou6 fan6 waan2 gaa1 dou1 gon2 zyu6 hoeng2 sau6 jau4 hei3 git3 cuk1 noi6 jung4，ji4 ngo5 zau6 zo6 hai2 paak3 maai6 coeng4 hoeng2 sau6 tou3 lei6 ge3 jau4 hei3：dong1 ngo5 lau4 ji3 dou3 di1 mat6 ban2 go2 zan6 zau6 ping4 di1 maai5，jin4 hau6 ji5 loek6 dai1 jyu1 zing3 soeng4 gaa3 cin4 zyun2 maai6 bei2 kei4 taa1 waan2 gaa1，hoeng2 sau6 lei6 jeon6。ni1 go3 hai6 mai6 zan1 hai6 waan2 jau4 hei3？wai3，ngo5 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam2 waan2 gan2，gam2 dim2 gaai2 m4 heoi3？
text: 大部分玩家都趕住享受遊戲結束內容，而我就坐喺拍賣場享受套利嘅遊戲：當我留意到啲物品嗰陣就平啲買，然後以略低於正常價錢轉賣畀其他玩家，享受利潤。呢個係咪真係玩遊戲？喂，我好開心噉玩緊，噉點解唔去？
